summary:
新紀元能源EPS超預期、營收年增7.27%，再生能源與電網投資成長穩健。
• EPS 1.09美元，超越預期1.03美元，正向驚喜5.67%
• 營收67億美元，年增7.27%動能穩健
• 受規範電力事業FPL提供穩定報酬基礎
• 再生能源開發龍頭地位受惠電力需求與AI資料中心用電
ai_view:
訊號正向：EPS超標與7.27%營收年增，反映受規範事業與再生能源雙引擎成長穩健，AI資料中心用電提供結構性需求題材。短中期股價有穩定盈餘成長與股利支撐，21.90倍本益比相對合理。中期關鍵在利率與政策環境。追蹤指標：再生能源開發簽約量與積壓專案、FPL費率基礎成長、調整後EPS年成長指引、資本支出計畫與融資成本，以及股利成長率。

需留意：利率走勢影響資本密集型再生能源專案融資成本；再生能源稅務抵減政策變動帶來不確定性；高負債與大額資本支出計畫考驗財務紀律

summary_en:
NextEra beat EPS with 7.27% revenue growth, as renewables and grid investment grew steadily.
• EPS of $1.09 beat the $1.03 estimate, a 5.67% positive surprise
• Revenue of $6.70B grew 7.27%, with steady momentum
• Regulated utility FPL provides a stable returns base
• Renewables development leadership benefits from power demand and AI data-center load

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: an EPS beat and 7.27% revenue growth reflect steady dual-engine growth from regulated utility and renewables, with AI data-center load providing a structural demand theme. Near to mid-term, the stock is supported by steady earnings growth and dividends, with a reasonable 21.90x P/E. Mid-term, rate and policy environments are key. Track: renewables origination signings and backlog, FPL rate-base growth, adjusted EPS growth guidance, capex program and financing costs, and dividend growth rate.

Watch：Rate trends affect financing costs for capital-intensive renewables projects; Changes to renewables tax-credit policy bring uncertainty; High debt and a large capex program test financial discipline
